A friend at Harvard Business School invited Kevin Trudeau to sit in on a class. Kevin was already making tens of millions a year.

The professor listed five things you must do in business. Kevin had never done one of them. Then five things you must never do. Kevin did all of them.

So he raised his hand: "What business do you own?" The professor had never owned one.

"I made ten million dollars last year doing the exact opposite of what you just said."

Listen to people who have what you want and have been where you are.

#kevintrudeau #harvard #business #entrepreneur #successmindset #yourwishisyourcommand

A hundred years ago, a millionaire was rich. In today's dollars that is $100 million cash in the bank.

So Kevin Trudeau asks a simple question: how many people teaching you how to get rich have $100 million in the bank?

His answer: almost none. They found something that worked for them once and now sell it as a system for everyone.

Before you take money advice, check who it is coming from.

#kevintrudeau #wealth #moneyadvice #financialfreedom #richmindset #success

You do the affirmations. You visualize every day. And your life still doesn't change.

Kevin Trudeau says the first reason is simple: most people can't even tell you the recipe.

Define what you don't want. Find out what you're disgusted with. Define what you do want. Write it down. See yourself in possession of it. Feel as if you already had it. Then release attachment to the outcome.

You have to know it like you know your own name. 90% of people don't.

#kevintrudeau #manifesting #lawofattraction #yourwishisyourcommand #goals #success

Ask people if it's good to have millions of dollars. Kevin Trudeau says about 80% answer no. It's bad.

Where does that come from? Beliefs passed down in your family. Money is the root of all evil. Rich people go to hell. You have to be poor to be good.

You say you want money, but underneath there's a vibration saying you don't. That's a counter intention, and it pushes money away.

It was never money that was the root of all evil. It was the love of money.

#kevintrudeau #moneymindset #abundance #limitingbeliefs #wealth #mindset

Most of us were raised on it: an honest day's work for an honest day's pay. Anything more is stealing.

So $200 for a day of hard work is honest. But $10,000 from two hours building something online? That feels wrong.

Kevin Trudeau calls that broke mentality. Wealth mentality says: I deserve to be paid well because I'm adding real value to people's lives.

You won't keep money you believe you don't deserve.

#kevintrudeau #wealthmindset #deserve #moneymindset #entrepreneur #success

J. Paul Getty, once the richest man in the world, wrote that successful people have success habits and failures have failure habits.

Kevin Trudeau says hand most people a list of 100 failure habits and they check 50 or 60. Hand it to someone worth $100 million and they check none.

The one that matters most: when a lawsuit hits or the plant burns down, do you get depressed? Winners don't. They get mad, take massive action and attack.

#kevintrudeau #habits #jpaulgetty #winnersmindset #resilience #success

The universe will always yield to your will.

Kevin Trudeau calls willpower the word manifesting circles don't like, because it means you have to decide.

That's why "success is a decision away" is true. When you say "I'm going to do it, period," doors open that were never there before.

Most people never take the authority they already have over their own lives.

#kevintrudeau #willpower #decision #manifesting #mindset #success

Kevin Trudeau says he was never taught to manifest. He was taught how to set a goal and achieve it, how to create the life you want, how to build wealth.

Every one of those phrases tells you to DO something. If you're building a sandcastle, you actually have to build.

Now say "I want to manifest wealth." What do you picture? Sitting there waiting for money to fall into your lap.

That's not how it works.

#kevintrudeau #manifesting #lawofattraction #takeaction #success #yourwishisyourcommand
